_source: Fowl Play design doc pp. 13-14 (modes, end of match, tokens)

modes.name: Zapper Only
modes.rule: Everyone keeps the starting pistol; the shop sells only attachments and Slop

modes.name: High Roller
modes.rule: Everyone starts with $1,000; money is the score

modes.name: Teams
modes.rule: Stalls 1-3 against 4-6 (or three pairs with 2v2v2); team bird totals; no sabotage on teammates

modes.name: Night Shoot
modes.rule: Dark rounds; birds have glowing eyes; flares are essential

modes.name: Mystery Box
modes.rule: No gun counter; the mystery-gun machine is free once per intermission

modes.name: Practice
modes.rule: Solo, no money, any gun, any bird
